roster.name: Kaguya / SELENE
roster.note: the largest lunar mission since Apollo — a Moon orbiter that mapped the surface in unprecedented detail and shot the first high-definition video of Earth rising over the lunar limb

after its orbit-insertion engine failed at Venus in 2010, the probe looped the Sun for five years and, on a second attempt, used its tiny attitude thrusters to slip into orbit — a mission saved from certain loss
the 'Moon Sniper' lands within 100 metres of its target — pinpoint precision no one had achieved — then survives a tipped-over touchdown to return science on solar power
